description: ENTSO-E Power Statistics are aggregated country-level statistics on the power systems of European transmission system operators, published by ENTSO-E together with monthly statistics reports, the Electricity in Europe report, the Yearly Statistics and Adequacy Retrospect and a yearly Statistical Factsheet. The download page offers monthly domestic values per country, hourly load aggregated by country, physical energy and power flows from country to country, yearly net generating capacity, and yearly inventories of generation and of transmission assets. Since 2019 the statistics are built from aggregations of Transparency Platform data; older archive files reach back to 1991 for monthly values, 2006 for hourly load and 1975 for the transmission inventory. When read on 26 September 2026 the 2026 files held the first and second quarters. Coverage is ENTSO-E member countries. Files are Excel and CSV workbooks and PDF factsheets, free to download without registration; no licence is stated on the download page. Caveats: the method changed in 2019, so series before and after are not strictly comparable, and national perimeters can differ from country borders as noted in the metadata. Simulation uses are long-run demand, flow and grid inventory inputs for adequacy and capacity planning models. Related records: data-entsoe-transparency-platform is the underlying source.
